identity.note: UFC athlete page: Petr Yan, bantamweight, Krasnoyarsk Krai, Russia, age 33, 21-5-0. Sovsport, AiF, Sherdog and ESPN profiles match by name, hometown and fight record.

wrestling.note: No wrestling credential found. AiF says he had only three wrestling sessions before his first MMA fight. UWW and Russian wrestling federation records were not searched.

grappling.note: No submission-grappling competition is mentioned in any source opened. ADCC was not searched.

judo.note: No source opened mentions judo. IJF and JudoInside were not searched.

kickboxing.note: No source opened mentions kickboxing. WAKO was not searched. Wikipedia and Sovsport mention ITF taekwondo as a child, with no competition record.

claims.text: Trained in boxing for about eight years and met the Russian Master of Sport standard in the 64 kg class.
claims.level_note: Russian Master of Sport ranking title in boxing

claims.text: Earned the Master of Sport title in boxing after training under Nikolai Surzhikov in Dudinka and Yuri Demchenko in Omsk, then moved to MMA in 2014.
claims.level_note: Russian Master of Sport ranking title in boxing

claims.text: The UFC athlete profile lists Master of Sport in boxing as one of his ranks and says he won youth regional championships in Russia.
claims.level_note: Russian Master of Sport ranking title in boxing

boxing.note: Master of Sport is a Russian sports-ranking title, not a medal. No amateur results or medals are listed in any source. No professional boxing record found on Boxerbook. BoxRec blocked automated access.

claims.text: The UFC athlete profile lists him as a Brazilian jiu-jitsu blue belt.

bjj.note: The only source is the UFC athlete profile, which is self-reported. No federation or lineage record was found. BJJ Heroes blocked automated access, and the IBJJF was not searched.

claims.text: Beat Artur Mirzakhanyan by first-round TKO at the Professional Combat Sambo Russia Cup.
ESPN lists his first-round KO/TKO win over Artur Mirzakhanyan at Professional Combat Sambo Russia Cup, dated February 2015.

sambo.note: This is a single professional combat sambo bout, also counted in his MMA record. The sources disagree on its date: Sherdog gives 5 July 2015 and ESPN gives 10 February 2015. No amateur sambo titles were found. FIAS records were not searched.
